```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(readxl)

ancestry_colors <- c("#add8e6", "#FEF5C3", "#fdc0cb")
```

```{r}
megatable <- read.csv("../data/pangenome_project_megatable.csv")

strelka <- megatable[c("Donor_ID", "Ancestry", "Reference", "Strelka_Precision", "Strelka_Recall", "Strelka_F1_Score")]
proportion <- megatable[c("Donor_ID", "Ancestry", "AA_Admixture_Proportion", "EA_Admixture_Proportion", "EAA_Admixture_Proportion")]
```

```{r}
colnames(proportion)[colnames(proportion) == "AA_Admixture_Proportion"] <- "AA"
colnames(proportion)[colnames(proportion) == "EA_Admixture_Proportion"] <- "EA"
colnames(proportion)[colnames(proportion) == "EAA_Admixture_Proportion"] <- "EAA"
```

# Useful functions
```{r}
rename_col <- function(df) {
  colnames(df)[grepl("_Recall$", colnames(df))] <- "Recall"
  colnames(df)[grepl("_Precision$", colnames(df))] <- "Precision"
  colnames(df)[grepl("_F1_Score$", colnames(df))] <- "F1_Score"
  return(df)
}

as_numeric <- function(df) {
  df <- df[df$Reference %in% c("Pangenome", "Linear"), ]
  df$F1_Score <- as.numeric(df$F1_Score)
  df$Precision <- as.numeric(df$Precision)
  df$Recall <- as.numeric(df$Recall)
  return(df)
}

delta_diff <- function(data) {
  pan <- data[data$Reference == "Pangenome", ]
  lin  <- data[data$Reference == "Linear", ]
  
  merged <- merge(pan, lin, by = "Donor_ID", suffixes = c("_Pangenome", "_Linear"))
  
  result <- data.frame(
    Donor_ID        = merged$Donor_ID,
    Ancestry        = merged$Ancestry_Pangenome,
    Delta_Recall    = merged$Recall_Pangenome - merged$Recall_Linear,
    Delta_Precision = merged$Precision_Pangenome - merged$Precision_Linear,
    Delta_F1_Score  = merged$F1_Score_Pangenome - merged$F1_Score_Linear
  )
  
  return(result)
}
```

# Process
```{r}
strelka <- rename_col(strelka)
strelka <- as_numeric(strelka)
delta_strelka <- delta_diff(strelka)

delta_strelka <- merge(delta_strelka, 
                       proportion[, c("Donor_ID", 
                                      "AA", 
                                      "EA", 
                                      "EAA")],
                       by = "Donor_ID", all.x = TRUE)
```

```{r}
scatterplot <- function(x_var, x_lab, legend) {
  x_var <- rlang::ensym(x_var)
  output <- ggplot(delta_strelka, aes(!!x_var, Delta_F1_Score, fill=Ancestry)) + 
    geom_point(
      size = 3, 
      alpha = 1,
      shape = 21,
      color = "black") +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0, 
      linetype = "solid", 
      color = "black", 
      size = 1) +
    labs(
      x = x_lab, 
      y = expression(paste(Delta, " F1 Score (%)"))) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(-45, 45),
      breaks = seq(-100, 100, 20)) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(-0.1, 1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = ancestry_colors,
      name = element_blank(),
      labels = c(
        "AA_Patients" = "African",
        "EA_Patients" = "European",
        "EAA_Patients" = "East Asian")) +
    theme(
      legend.position = legend,
      legend.position.inside = c(0.85, 0.15),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      # panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#F0F0F0"),
      # panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(color = "#F0F0F0"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20), 
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20), 
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.line.y.left   = element_line(color = "black")
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = -Inf, y = Inf,
      label = "Pangenome - Linear",
      size = 6,
      color = "black",
      hjust = -0.1,
      vjust = 2
    )
  
  return(output)
}
```

AA_output
